Sonia Gandhi memoir 'Belonging' to be published by HarperCollins India

HarperCollins India announced on September 4 that it will publish Sonia Gandhi's memoir titled 'Belonging'. The publisher described the book as a "surprising, richly told memoir" that "seamlessly weaves the personal with the political to tell a riveting story." HarperCollins India will publish the memoir after Penguin India reportedly backed out. Mint described 'Belonging' as a "dramatic and deeply personal story of love, identity, duty and belonging, and offers a rare insider's view of India’s journey."
